comments.note: mcp-server/src/utils/workflow-helpers.ts line 160: `const developerReworkTypes: PipelineType[] = ['qa', 'code-review']` is hardcoded inline rather than derived from FAIL_ROUTING_MAP in pipeline-maps.ts. If routing changes, this list will silently drift — the function would produce incorrect 're-engaged' signals for the Developer recommendation engine. Recommended fix: derive at call-site via `Object.entries(FAIL_ROUTING_MAP).filter(([,a]) => a === 'Developer').map(([t]) => t as PipelineType).filter(t => t !== 'implementation')`, or at minimum add a comment explicitly cross-referencing FAIL_ROUTING_MAP as the authoritative source. This is a silent-drift risk, hence medium priority.

hasDownstreamReengagedSince() uses `dsStartedAt >= upstreamCompletedAt` (inclusive). This is the correct, safe interpretation — concurrent-millisecond start treated as re-engaged errs on the side of preventing redundant rework cycles. No change needed.
